answer_text: Vidya Mandir, Delhi 26 August 2026 The Editor, Daily Nation Subject: Promote digital safety for every age group Sir/Madam I am Amitha, Vice Head Girl of Vidya Mandir. Unauthorised use of networks and devices is no longer a rare crime. Fraud, stolen identities and broken accounts frighten students as well as grandparents who cannot judge a scam message. Lack of basic caution multiplies the risk. We need nationwide digital literacy, not slogans alone. Schools and workplaces should run short courses on passwords, safe browsing and reporting abuse. Community centres can help older citizens. The state must tighten cyber law and response. A national daily can start that conversation so individuals, firms and government share the duty of keeping people safe online. Yours sincerely Amitha
